title: Semantics-Empowered Space-Air-Ground-Sea Integrated Network: New Paradigm, Frameworks, and Challenges
affiliation: Harbin Institute of Technology (Shenzhen) / Nanjing University / Peng Cheng Laboratory
domain: Semantic Communications / SAGSIN / 6G / Deep Learning / Task-Oriented Communications / PCCAIP
paper_type: Comprehensive Survey with Novel Paradigm Proposal

analysis_policy.focus: Extract paradigm framing, three-perspective organization, and multi-modal technique coverage patterns
analysis_policy.depth: Full paper analysis including PCCAIP framework, SPT/MET/EYT techniques, DNN models, metrics

section_flow.title: Introduction
subsections: Related Surveys & Tutorials on Semantic Communications
section_flow.summary: Establishes 6G SAGSIN context, identifies gap between Shannon-limited traditional communications and semantic needs. Poses three guiding questions, introduces three semantics interpretations (significance, meaning, effectiveness).
key_claims: Shannon limit reached - new revolution needed
Bit-level reconstruction unnecessary for M2M applications
Term 'semantics' has three interpretations in literature

section_flow.title: Perception, Computing, and Actuation for Semantic Communications in the SAGSIN
section_flow.summary: Proposes novel PCCAIP paradigm with closed-loop framework. Emergency rescue scenario illustrates target-perception-communication-actuation-target loop. Differentiates from ISAC/ISCC.
key_claims: PCCAIP differs from ISAC/ISCC in semantic focus and actuation integration
Edge computing enables semantic encoding on satellites

section_flow.title: Perception-Communication-Integrated Semantic Communications: A Data Significance Perspective
section_flow.summary: Covers AoI and variants (nonlinear AoI, AoS, AoII, UoI, GoT) as significance metrics. Reviews SPTs: significance-oriented sampling, coding (HARQ variants), modulation (NOMA power allocation).
key_claims: HARQ-IR benefits depend on propagation delay threshold

section_flow.title: Perception-Communication-Computing-Integrated Semantic Communications: A Meaning Extraction and Reconstruction Perspective
section_flow.summary: Comprehensive DNN-based semantic communication coverage. Metrics by modality (text: BLEU/BERT; image: PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS/FID; speech: SDR/PESQ). DNN taxonomy (CNN/RNN/Transformer/GAN). METs for multi-modal sources.
key_claims: Learning-based metrics better capture meaning similarity
DeepJSCC outperforms SSCC in finite blocklength regime
Transformer enables parallel processing for long sequences

section_flow.title: Perception-Communication-Computing-Actuation-Integrated Semantic Communications: An Ultimate Effectiveness Perspective
section_flow.summary: Task-oriented communications covering classification, retrieval, control tasks. Effectiveness metrics (accuracy, precision, recall, F1). EYTs for image classification, VQA, control, multi-modal sensing.
key_claims: Task-oriented design reduces computing resource consumption
Multi-modal semantic fusion enhances task effectiveness

section_flow.title: Future Challenges on Semantic Communications in the SAGSIN
section_flow.summary: Five future directions: robustness (channel/semantic noise), scheduling, security (eavesdropping, semantic attacks), cooperation (federated learning), generative AI (LLM for compression).
key_claims: Semantic noise distinct from channel noise

section_flow.title: Conclusions
section_flow.summary: Summarizes PCCAIP paradigm and three semantic communication system types with their corresponding techniques (SPT, MET, EYT).

rhetorical_contract.promise: Propose comprehensive paradigm (PCCAIP) for semantic communications in SAGSIN addressing three interpretations of semantics
rhetorical_contract.delivery_mechanism: Paradigm Proposal → Significance-Oriented → Meaning-Oriented → Effectiveness-Oriented → Future Challenges
rhetorical_contract.unique_contribution: First survey linking SAGSIN fundamental limitations to semantic communication design through unified PCCAIP paradigm

reusable_writing_recipes.description: Open the introduction by posing three numbered research questions that the survey will answer, providing clear reader expectations
structure: State 'This survey is dedicated to answering the following three questions'
Questions progress from conceptual (what is X) to design to implementation
Structure survey sections around answering these questions
reusable_writing_recipes.example_application: Section I-A: Question 1 (interpret semantics), Question 2 (design systems), Question 3 (utilize SAGSIN resources)
reusable_writing_recipes.rhetorical_effect: Sets clear expectations; creates narrative arc; reader engagement hook

reusable_writing_recipes.description: Ground key terminology by exploring its etymological origins followed by multiple interpretations

Map interpretations to system types throughout survey
reusable_writing_recipes.example_application: 'Semantics' → Greek 'semanticós' = significance → common meaning = meaning → effectiveness-related information
reusable_writing_recipes.rhetorical_effect: Academic authority; comprehensive conceptual coverage; structured organization

reusable_writing_recipes.description: Conclude each major section with a dedicated 'Lessons Learned' subsection summarizing key takeaways
